classes.name: ReportedOperationEventLifecycle
classes.description: Deep private Chisei module whose interface owns externally reported receipt-event admission, authorization, bounded validation, causal ordering, durable append, completeness, and Kioku attribution.

classes.name: CanonicalOperationReceipt
classes.description: Durable authoritative receipt whose ordered events record the governed operation decision path and completeness.

classes.name: ChiseiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that supplies authenticated transport context and delegates reported Operation Receipt event admission to the private lifecycle.

relations.name: delegates_reported_operation_event_to
relations.description: The Chisei gRPC transport delegates reported receipt-event admission to the lifecycle module.

relations.name: appends_to_canonical_operation_receipt
relations.description: The lifecycle validates and durably appends an authorized reported event to its canonical Operation Receipt.
